references.text: Defines the sanctuary shekel as twenty gerahs, the same standard measure used in Leviticus 27:25
Confirms that the shekel according to the sanctuary weight is twenty gerahs, used for ransom money
Uses the sanctuary shekel as the standard for ransom money, the same unit of weight as in Leviticus 27:25
Ezekiel defines the shekel as twenty gerahs, the same standard as the sanctuary shekel in the Mosaic Law
Shows the use of the sanctuary shekel as the standard measure for collections for the tabernacle
